query_sampling: Uniform order statistics over valid known physical fish observations; same query positions for every feature on each view
gallery: Every earlier same-video/same-view pilot observation, including unknown detector identities and unavailable features. No GT-favored proposal filtering.
pair_metrics: Current known query versus nearest earlier same-known-fish positive, and same-frame different-known-fish negatives; unknowns excluded from negative labels, retained in retrieval galleries.
scope: Sparse two-crop identity diagnostic, not accepted-history/GRU or full-online MOT. Backbone exposure and source numeric drift explicit; all features use identical per-view queries and temporal gallery masks.
